---
name: Bug report
about: Something in the remake looks or behaves wrong
labels: bug
---

**Screen.** What is on screen when it happens (title, menu, battle ...), or its id from `ACCEPTANCE.md`, e.g. SP-04 (planet scan).

**What happened, and what you expected.**

**Steps to get there** (keys or clicks, as far as you remember).

**Save.** If you can: Esc menu → S-Save & Quit, then attach the save slot or `CHARINFO.BAS` if you can export it. Saves contain your game state only.

**Browser and version** (e.g. Chrome 130 on Windows 11). Keyboard or mouse?

**Does the original DOS game do the same?** yes / no / don't know. If yes, it gets the "original did this too" label
and is still useful.

Please do not attach or link any original game files.
